subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRefs become startup-fatal under the existing eager secrets contract, or should this fix be sequenced with the optional-TTS degradation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: The collection fix is necessary, but registering these paths changes an existing user's failure mode from localized TTS unavailability to possible whole-Gateway startup failure; code inspection cannot choose that product boundary.

options.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
options.body: Fix the collector and proof now, but land it together with or after the narrowly reviewed optional-TTS missing-secret degradation path.

options.title: Accept startup fail-fast
options.body: Land the corrected collector after real consumer proof and explicitly accept that every configured persona TTS SecretRef is required for Gateway startup.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
recommendation.body: Fix the collector and proof now, but land it together with or after the narrowly reviewed optional-TTS missing-secret degradation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the eager SecretRef activation and target-coverage architecture they introduced and expanded.
